title: Banking: Transfers, Fraud Detection, and Audit Logging
description: Design atomic transfers, fraud detection rules, and immutable audit logs.

data.text: Extend the banking system with atomic transfers between accounts, fraud detection heuristics, and an immutable audit log for compliance.

data.title: TransferService and FraudDetection
Why audit logs?
data.text: Banks are legally required to track every transaction. An append-only audit log with timestamps, user IDs, and amounts satisfies compliance and enables forensic analysis.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: TransferService uses a repository pattern for accounts
Withdraw and Deposit happen in sequence within a DB transaction
FraudDetection checks velocity and threshold rules
data.takeaway: Banking transfers require atomicity. Fraud detection adds a rules layer on top. Audit logging is non-negotiable for compliance.
